Status Perfectus.

>>G
>
>And just to be clear, are the effects from both minions strikes now
>resolved if the rot is interupted?

No. Rotshrek ends combat. the 'interrupty' card doesn't cancel all of
rotschrek, it just cancels all the bits after the bit where it says to
end combat. You then carry on from wherever your interrupty card says
you do.
eg: psyche: new combat, TT: new round, etc.

> Or do you ignore those strikes and
>carry on with the new round of combat? What about additional strikes
>in the current round?

the 'current' round is over as soon as rotschrek is played (although
apparently other meths might be able to interrupt it at the point it
is played to tap a card cycling card to try and get a sudden for the
rotschrek).

> Status Perfectus.

Sudden Reversal. Anything that cancels the effect of R. as it is played
or that continues combat or starts a new combat.

>>And just to be clear, are the effects from both minions strikes now
>>resolved if the rot is interupted?
>
> No. Rotshrek ends combat. the 'interrupty' card doesn't cancel all of
> rotschrek, it just cancels all the bits after the bit where it says to
> end combat. You then carry on from wherever your interrupty card says
> you do.
> eg: psyche: new combat, TT: new round, etc.

Right. If you start a new combat when R. ends the first one, R. has still
ended the first one.

If you cancel R. with Sudden Reversal, though, then R. doesn't end
combat - you complete the combat as normal.

>> Or do you ignore those strikes and
>>carry on with the new round of combat? What about additional strikes
>>in the current round?
>
> the 'current' round is over as soon as rotschrek is played (although
> apparently other meths might be able to interrupt it at the point it
> is played to tap a card cycling card to try and get a sudden for the
> rotschrek).

Correct.
